D/14 WPSS No.478 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Dr. Kartikey Hari Gupta and Mr. Rafat 
Munir Ali, Advocates for the petitioners.
 Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, Additional Chief 
Standing Counsel for the State/respondent 
nos.1 and 2.
 Mr. B.D. Pande, Advocate for respondent 
no.3. 
 Learned counsel for the petitioners would 
submit that the petitioners had applied for 
Assistant Teacher LT (English). Under GEN￾EX (General Ex-Army), their names were
reflected in the select list, but in the final 
recommendation, their names are missing.
 The Court wanted to know from the 
learned counsel for the Uttarakhand 
Subordinate Service Selection Commission/ 
respondent no.3, as to how could it happen? 
How is this mistake done? He seeks time to 
get instructions. 
 List on 08.04.2025.
 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 03.04.2025
Sanjay
